name: TechJury

sources.title: Homepage — SaaS coupons + 'data-backed' product reviews site (25,751+ coupons, 138 categories)
Contact page — 'If you're a company interested in seeing your products or services reviewed on our pages, let's talk!'

requirements: No self-serve submission — coverage is editorial. Companies request a review via the contact form or email
Fit: software/SaaS products they can test — 'Our team thoroughly tests every software subscription before recommending it'
Site also runs exclusive coupons/deals — a discount offer improves odds of a deal listing
Affiliate-supported ('we may earn a commission') — expect affiliate-link economics to matter for commercial placement
preparation: A pitch explaining what the product does and why it merits a data-backed review
Product access for their testing team (account/license)
Optional: an exclusive coupon/deal for their audience (their primary content format is deals + reviews)
Contact via the form at https://techjury.net/contact-us/
workflow: Open https://techjury.net/contact-us/ and use the contact form (or the listed email)
Request a product review and/or propose an exclusive coupon deal
If accepted, their team tests the software and publishes a review/deal listing
watchFor: Review is not guaranteed — editorial discretion; no public review criteria or SLA
Site blocks simple bots (403 on plain fetches) — use a real browser UA
The site is primarily a coupons/affiliate engine now — a review without a deal or affiliate program may be deprioritized
Operator is IMPROV MEDIA - FZCO (Dubai) — portfolio media site, not an indie community
countsAsLive: A review article under /product-analysis/ or a coupon/deal page featuring your product is published on techjury.net
unknowns: Whether reviews are ever paid/sponsored and on what terms
Response rate to cold review requests
Whether product links in reviews are dofollow or affiliate-wrapped
